title: CareLine Service Plans — Plan Fee and Term Schedule
content:
**Service Pricing Desk schedule — CareLine Service Plans**

Every account in the CareLine Service Plans family runs in terms. The plan fee shown below is the fee for one whole term, and it is billed in advance at the start of each term. Plan years are counted from the enrolled date: each plan year begins on an anniversary of the enrolled date.

| Tier | Term length | Plan fee per term (USD) | When the plan fee is billed | How plan years are counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 12 months | 0.00 | In advance, each term | From each anniversary of the enrolled date |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 12 months | 129.00 | In advance, each term | From each anniversary of the enrolled date |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 12 months | 189.00 | In advance, each term | From each anniversary of the enrolled date |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 12 months | 249.00 | In advance, each term | From each anniversary of the enrolled date |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 36 months | 669.00 | In advance, each term | From each anniversary of the enrolled date |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 12 months | 389.00 | In advance, each term | From each anniversary of the enrolled date |

### Notes to the schedule

- The On-Call Service Account is the pay-per-visit account: it carries no annual fee, and its plan fee per term is 0.00.
- The CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan is sold as a prepaid term: its 36-month term is paid with one plan fee of 669.00, billed in advance for the whole term.
- A term and a plan year are different measures. On every 12-month tier one term spans one plan year. On the CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan one term of 36 months spans three plan years, each beginning on an anniversary of the enrolled date.

### Reading the schedule (hypothetical enrolled date)

Taking a hypothetical enrolled date of 15 March in some year:

| Tier | Plan years inside the first term | Plan fee billed at the start of the first term |
|---|---|---|
| CareLine Plus Plan | One plan year, beginning 15 March | 189.00, billed in advance |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | Three plan years, beginning on 15 March of the first, second and third year | 669.00, billed in advance once for the 36 months |
| On-Call Service Account | One plan year, beginning 15 March | 0.00 |

### Points of reading

**Is the 669.00 on the CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan a yearly figure?** No. It is the plan fee for the full 36-month term, billed in advance once per term.

**When does a new plan year start on any CareLine Service Plans tier?** On the anniversary of the enrolled date, whatever the tier.
